rules.sentence: Management of Jacobsen syndrome may also include surgery for orthopedic and skeletal abnormalities, the use of hearing and vision aids, and cardiac surgery for congenital heart defects.
Many patients benefit from physical, occupational, and speech therapy, in addition to special education and behavioral therapy.
Depending on disease severity, cardiac defects may require surgical intervention within the first few months to years of life.
